ISTJ.name: The Logistician
ISTJ.description: Practical people who think based on facts and act rationally.
ISTJ.detailedDescription: You have a strong sense of responsibility and prefer orderly environments. Diligence and perseverance are your greatest weapons, and you demonstrate the responsibility to see through what you start. While you may be conservative about change, your stability serves as a reliable pillar in organizations and families.

ISFJ.name: The Defender
ISFJ.description: Dedicated people who pour their hearts into protecting those they care about.
ISFJ.detailedDescription: You enjoy carefully attending to the needs of those around you and helping them. Humble and warm, you find great fulfillment not only in your own work but also in helping others. While you may sometimes put your own needs second, your dedication makes the world a warmer place.

INFJ.name: The Advocate
INFJ.description: Quiet, mystical idealists with tireless inspiration.
INFJ.detailedDescription: You appear quiet on the outside, but hide passionate fervor and deep insight within. You feel a calling to discover and help people's hidden potential, and have a vision to create a better world. Your warm insights resonate deeply with those around you.

INTJ.name: The Architect
INTJ.description: Imaginative strategists who develop thorough plans.
INTJ.detailedDescription: You enjoy understanding and improving complex systems with keen observation and logical thinking. You have your own high standards and perform best when working independently. While you may seem cold at times, your strategic thinking finds a way through any difficulty.

challenges: Lack of Consideration for Others' Feelings
ISTP.name: The Virtuoso
ISTP.description: Bold, practical experimenters skilled with all kinds of tools.
ISTP.detailedDescription: You have an exceptional ability to observe situations and find immediate solutions. Even without many words, you show natural talent in creating things with your hands or handling machinery. Calmly dealing with any crisis, you are a true practitioner.

ISFP.name: The Adventurer
ISFP.description: Flexible, charming artists always ready to explore something new.
ISFP.detailedDescription: You cherish the present moment and express the world through your aesthetic sense. Charming and kind, you try to avoid conflict with others. Your unique artistic sensitivity gives fresh inspiration to those around you and softens the atmosphere.

INFP.name: The Mediator
INFP.description: Poetic, kind, and altruistic people who always want to help a good cause.
INFP.detailedDescription: You are a romantic who lives by your own values and beliefs. You excel at discovering the goodness and potential hidden within people, and sometimes express your deep feelings through writing. Your warm empathy and consideration become a warm light in a cold world.

INTP.name: The Logician
INTP.description: Innovative inventors with an endless thirst for knowledge.
INTP.detailedDescription: You enjoy delving into the world's principles and finding logical contradictions. You excel at connecting abstract ideas and concepts, constantly exploring to satisfy your intellectual curiosity. Your original way of thinking becomes the driving force for presenting new paradigms.

ESTP.name: The Entrepreneur
ESTP.description: Smart, energetic people with excellent insight who enjoy adventure.
ESTP.detailedDescription: You prefer immediate feedback and like to learn by experiencing things hands-on in the field. You lead the atmosphere around you with overflowing energy and have an exceptional sense for capturing practical opportunities. Your decisiveness and action change any stagnant situation.

ESFP.name: The Entertainer
ESFP.description: Spontaneous, energetic, and passionate people who delight those around them.
ESFP.detailedDescription: You are someone who enjoys the present moment to the fullest. Optimistic and sociable, you have a natural talent for making others happy. Your bright energy is contagious to those around you and brings vitality to the community.

ENFP.name: The Campaigner
ENFP.description: Passionate, creative, and sociable free spirits who always find reasons to smile.
ENFP.detailedDescription: You enjoy emotionally connecting with people and have a very rich imagination. New ideas overflow with enthusiasm, and you excel at drawing out the potential in those around you. Your warm insight and energy give people new hope.

challenges: May Be Misunderstood Due to Loving Debate
ENTP.name: The Debater
ENTP.description: Smart, curious thinkers who don't fear intellectual challenges.
ENTP.detailedDescription: You enjoy flipping existing ideas and exploring new possibilities. You lead intellectual discussions with witty remarks and logical arguments, and have the ability to view any problem from multiple angles. Your innovative perspective becomes the power to break conventions.

ESTJ.name: The Executive
ESTJ.description: Excellent administrators with unparalleled skill in managing things and people.
ESTJ.detailedDescription: You respect tradition and order and consider it important to establish and follow clear rules. You have excellent organizational skills that maximize efficiency and are a reliable leader who faithfully fulfills commitments. Your decisiveness brings stability to chaotic situations.

ESFJ.name: The Consul
ESFJ.description: Popular people who are attentive and sociable towards others and enthusiastic about helping them.
ESFJ.detailedDescription: You value harmony and balance and carefully consider those around you. You cherish community rules and traditions and work diligently to meet the expectations of others. Your warm sociability plays a powerful role as an airbag that binds people together.

ENFJ.name: The Protagonist
ENFJ.description: Charismatic, inspiring leaders who captivate audiences.
ENFJ.detailedDescription: You have a natural talent for helping people grow and leading them to a better future. You have excellent empathy and display powerful charisma that unites people for a common goal. Your leadership becomes a positive force that transforms those around you.

challenges: Can Be Dominant Over Others' Opinions
ENTJ.name: The Commander
ENTJ.description: Bold, imaginative leaders with powerful will who always find a way or make one.
ENTJ.detailedDescription: You excel at formulating long-term visions and devising concrete strategies to realize them. You possess cold logic and strong drive, leading organizations efficiently to produce results. No matter what obstacles come your way, you break through head-on to claim victory.
